package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"

	gin "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for repeated_body_rewind_for_multiple_decoders: Gin handlers that read, rewind, and decode the same request body multiple times.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.
type Rule333PositiveRecord struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Email string `json:"email"`
}

func scenario333Positive(c *gin.Context) {
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(c.Request.Body)
	c.Request.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(body))

	var record Rule333PositiveRecord
	if err := json.NewDecoder(c.Request.Body).Decode(&record); err != nil {
		c.JSON(400, gin.H{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	c.Request.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(body))

	var audit map[string]any
	json.NewDecoder(c.Request.Body).Decode(&audit)
	c.JSON(200, gin.H{"record": record})
}
